title: OpenAI again shakes up data center leadership, with xAI exec Uday Ruddarraju to lead and Sachin Katti to leave
key_facts: OpenAI put compute and infrastructure under Uday Ruddarraju, who ran infrastructure at Elon Musk's xAI until July 2025.
Sachin Katti, who oversaw infrastructure, leaves the role within weeks and stays on as an adviser.
Bloomberg reported the change on Wednesday 14 Oct 2026.
Ruddarraju joined OpenAI in July 2025 and became chief technology officer for compute this July.
Katti led the $30 billion Georgia build and an 8-gigawatt Ohio project with SB Energy and Nvidia.
Peter Hoeschele, central to Stargate, left for Meta earlier this year.
quote_evidence: OpenAI has put compute and infrastructure under one executive.
Bloomberg reported the change on Wednesday.
why_it_matters_hint: Leadership changes at the team building OpenAI's computing capacity.
